selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop exploration and hunting sequence. The agent must first locate the plains biome, where both rabbits and donkeys naturally spawn. Finding the river serves as a navigation landmark that borders plains biomes. Once the agent has found the plains, they can hunt a rabbit (which spawns in plains). The donkey also spawns in plains, but hunting a donkey is more challenging (larger mob, more health), so it logically follows after the rabbit hunt as the agent is already oriented in the correct biome. The river acts as a geographic boundary between biomes, helping the agent navigate from spawn to the plains area where the animals are located.

edges.reason: The river borders the plains biome; crossing/following the river leads the agent to the plains area
Rabbits spawn in plains biome; agent must locate plains first to find rabbits to hunt
Donkeys spawn in plains biome; agent must locate plains first to find donkeys to hunt
Hunting the smaller rabbit first builds combat readiness before tackling the larger donkey

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find river' is an observation/locate task. The target is the center of the water channel at relative (10, 0, 0). The player must walk east ~8 blocks from spawn to get within range of the river and face it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has intentionally approached the river (spawn is at x=0, water starts at x=8). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the water.

Uses position_inside_box because 'find plains' is a navigation/movement task requiring the player to cross the river and reach the grass plains area on the east side. The box starts at x=15 (well past the river at x=8-12) and extends to x=25, covering the full plains area where mobs are located. Y range is generous (-3 to 5) and Z covers the full scene width.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='mob' and max_count=0 because this is a kill/combat task. The generous box (±20 around the rabbit spawn area center at x=19, z=2) ensures rabbits stay inside the detection zone even if they flee. When all rabbits in the box are dead (count=0), the task is complete. Only 1 needs to die but checking for at_most 3 (since 4 spawned) would be fragile - instead we use a focused box around one rabbit pair.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='mob' and max_count=0 because this is a kill/combat task. The generous box (spanning the entire scene) ensures donkeys stay inside the detection zone even if they wander. With 2 donkeys spawned, max_count=1 means at least one has been killed. The box is very generous (±20) to prevent false positives from donkeys walking out.

scene_description: A flat grass landscape with the player spawning on the west side. A north-south water channel (river) with sand banks runs ~8-10 blocks east of spawn. Beyond the river is an open plains area where 4 rabbits and 2 donkeys roam. The player is equipped with a diamond sword for hunting.
task_text: Find the river to the east, cross it to reach the plains on the other side, then hunt a rabbit and hunt a donkey using your diamond sword.
design_notes: Player spawns at (0,0,0) relative. River runs at x=8-12 relative (sand at x=7-13). Plains area is x>13. Rabbits at x=18-21, z=-2 to 6. Donkeys at x=22-24, z=5-8. Player must walk ~8 blocks east to reach river, then cross 5-block water channel, then continue ~5 blocks to reach mobs. Total traversal ~18 blocks. 4 rabbits for redundancy against flee behavior. Platform is 30x30 blocks providing ample space.
